executiveSummary.title: WHAT THE DATA SAYS
executiveSummary.narrative:
Tampa Airport Marriott appeared in at least one AI answer for 12.5% of the traveler needs we tested, and across every individual AI answer it appeared 4.2% of the time. Together, these results show how broadly AI recognizes the hotel and how consistently a traveler would encounter it.

Among AI answers where hotel ranking could be measured, Tampa Airport Marriott appeared in the Top 3 0% of the time, showing how prominently it is positioned when AI includes it.

AI currently reflects 21.1% of the monitored facts and attributes that define the hotel, so important parts of the property proposition are not consistently represented in AI results. No comparable prior official monitoring period is available yet, so change over time is not shown.

sections.headline: Tampa Airport Marriott's primary issue is entering AI consideration at all, especially for Leisure Travel.
sections.keyInsight: AI Consideration is 4.2%, so the hotel appears in only a limited share of individual comparable responses. When the hotel is absent, JW Marriott Tampa Water Street is a leading observed alternative in those gaps — an evidence lead for review, not an automatic proof of recurring substitution. Rank tactics have limited value until relevance improves. The binding constraint is becoming part of the answer set for the traveler needs the hotel currently misses.
sections.whyItMatters: Fine-tuning rank against individual competitors will have limited value until the hotel becomes relevant in more of the traveler needs it currently misses. Entry problems and rank problems require different management attention. If leadership optimizes competitor comparisons first, the hotel can look busy while still missing the larger answer-set gap.
sections.focusNow: Focus first on how the hotel is represented for Leisure Travel. Review whether the attributes, positioning, and use cases most relevant to those travelers are complete and consistently represented across priority sources. Treat competitor-rank tactics as secondary until entry improves.
sections.whatToReview: Compare evidence from scenarios where JW Marriott Tampa Water Street appears with the property information currently available for Tampa Airport Marriott. Check entry cues first — product type, occasion, and location framing — before broadening the review to secondary attributes.
